decisions.reason: As the most prominently presented 2023 launch, it still looks like a live option whose uncertainty has not fully resolved and whose near-term holding cost is likely modest.
It has weaker commitment signals than A, but after only about a year on the market a small chemical firm would usually keep this option open unless clearer evidence of poor prospects appears.
This product appears less strongly backed than A and may face overlap and competition, but its short market history still favors keeping it for now rather than abandoning it immediately.
